tool.name: Biomni: Get Fda Drug Label Info
tool.help:
**Biomni: Get Fda Drug Label Info**
Retrieve FDA drug label information.
Args: drug_name: Name of the drug to query sections: Optional list of specific sections to retrieve ["indications_and_usage", "contraindications", "warnings", "dosage_and_administration"]
Returns: Formatted string with drug label information
**Domain**: pharmacology **Function**: get_fda_drug_label_info
